summary: Celcuity Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 30, 2026, furnishing a press release under Items 7.01 and 8.01 announcing that REVTORPYK (gedatolisib), its PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway inhibitor, is now commercially available in the United States for HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer without a detected PIK3CA mutation following progression on at least one line of endocrine therapy. The filing contains no transactional, ownership, or pricing terms; it is a routine commercial-launch and Regulation FD disclosure, not a merger, tender, spin-off, or activist event. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are implicated; there is no risk-arb angle.
